name: mash
description: A standards-oriented Web Components design system: DTCG tokens -> Style Dictionary -> CSS; TypeScript -> tsc -> ES modules + custom-elements.json.

scripts.//build: Order is a real dependency, not a preference: components consume the token CSS, and @mash/shrine composes @mash/ui. `pnpm -r` runs in workspace-dependency order, so declaring the dependency in package.json is what sequences the build — there is no order list here to fall out of date.
scripts.//build:parts: The same work as `build`, addressable one stage at a time. CI names these so a failure reads as `tokens` or `manifest` rather than as a line inside one long log.
scripts.//build:catalog: The artifact Vercel serves as the PR preview. The trailing `...` selects the catalog *and its workspace dependencies*, so pnpm builds tokens -> ui -> shrine -> catalog in dependency order from a cold tree. The ordering lives in the dependency graph rather than in a sequence of commands someone has to remember to run — Vercel, CI and a developer all run this one command.
scripts.//build:vercel: Builds the catalog and browser IIFE, then publishes the IIFE only when Vercel marks the build as a deployed environment. Local and GitHub CI runs stop after the deterministic build.
scripts.build:vercel: pnpm run build:catalog && pnpm run publish:iife
scripts.//dev: Build once so nothing starts against a missing dist/, then watch tokens, components and the manifest alongside the catalog.
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --parallel run dev
scripts.check: pnpm run check:format && pnpm run check:types && pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:exports && pnpm run check:parts && pnpm run check:catalogue && pnpm run check:tokens && pnpm run check:ontology && pnpm run check:paper
scripts.//new:component: Scaffolds a component and wires it into the package's barrels and exports map. Usage: pnpm new:component <package> <tag-name>
scripts.//test:browser: An alias for `test`, named for what it is: component tests in a real browser. CI uses the explicit name.
scripts.//test:visual: Screenshot baselines are platform-specific; see tests/visual/README.md before running this outside CI.
